C02 shares the basic reluctant-acceptance and departmental-accomplishment structure, but is more generic.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It is with very great reluctance that I accept your resignation as Secretary of Defense effective, in accordance with your wishes, on September twelfth.","parent_excerpt":"Because of those urgent personal considerations about which you have spoken to me so many times, I accept your resignation effective at the close of business on March thirty-first. Although I take this action reluctantly...","explanation":"Both use nearly the same operative acceptance formula: acknowledged personal reasons, reluctant acceptance, office, and a precise effective date."},{"child_excerpt":"I am most appreciative of your willingness to remain two months beyond our agreement","parent_excerpt":"At my personal urging you have agreed to remain in Washington far beyond the time when you had expressed a hope of leaving government service.","explanation":"This is a particularly concrete shared element: the departing Defense Secretary postponed retirement at the President's request."},{"child_excerpt":"I have stated many times... my high regard for your many services to the country throughout your long and distinguished career as a government servant.","parent_excerpt":"Your service to your country covering a period of almost nine years... has been as varied as it has been distinguished.","explanation":"Both transition from the resignation to a retrospective assessment of long and distinguished national service."},{"child_excerpt":"the tremendous strides that have been made, under your direct leadership, in establishing a sound basis for our military manpower and production program","parent_excerpt":"you directed a production program which made the American Navy the greatest sea power in history. It then fell to you to assume even larger responsibilities as the country's first Secretary of Defense.","explanation":"Each highlights concrete military-production and Defense Department leadership accomplishments."},{"child_excerpt":"On behalf of our country I want to thank you... my deep personal appreciation for the wise counsel and the unwavering support you have given me","parent_excerpt":"I know you will be standing by to give advice and counsel...
